title: 45-Minute By The Park Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This tour is wheelchair accessible. As long as you are able to get out of your wheelchair, the tour operator will keep it safe at the carriage stand throughout the duration of your tour.
Not recommended for travelers with mobility issues.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the tranquil beauty of Beacon Hill Park on this relaxing horse-drawn carriage ride. You'll discover why this vast park is one of downtown Victoria's crown jewels as you ride leisurely past ponds and lush greenery brimming with colorful flowers. Throughout your ride, your experienced carriage driver will entertain you with tales of Victoria's past, present and future. Tour route subject to change.
